messages:
matt: Heads-up — we need a quick cross-team sync on the new dashboard metrics for traces. Console wants per-route latency + ability to link into full trace by request id. Need runtime/infra input on which headers and tags we can rely on at the edge and what sampling info we can surface.

jana: SGTM. Current runtime emits W3C traceparent and X-Request-ID on all outgoing calls. We do not currently propagate a standardized "sampled" header across internal hops (only internal span flags).

khurana: Important: the public edge (api-gw) currently strips unknown incoming headers for security. We can whitelist a short list (W3C traceparent, X-Request-ID, and a custom one) but must limit cardinality.

lina: Also from SRE perspective — we need to be careful about high-cardinality tags. request_id is high-card but OK as a lookup key to zoom into traces. Dashboards should not aggregate by request_id. We prefer low-cardinality tags: route, env, sampled, region.

ash: +1 (quick note: prefer tag name 'sampled' boolean rather than raw sample rate in most dashboards)

ash (typo correction): sorry — meant ash: +1 on sampled boolean. For UI we want a p50/p95/p99 per-route adjusted for sampling, and an expand action to open trace waterfall by request id.

matt: Proposed minimal contract for telemetry/logs/metrics at ingress and runtime:
```
# fields we want in structured logs/metrics/events
req_id: <X-Request-ID>
trace_id: <from traceparent>
span_id: <current span id>
sampled: <true|false>  # propagated decision
route: <route_name>     # low-cardinality route identifier
latency_ms: <int>
status: <http_status>
```
We will push these as tags on metrics and as fields in structured logs so Console can join them.

jana: Runtime can emit all that. Implementation notes: we'll add an explicit header X-RW-Trace-Sampled set to "1" or "0" at the edge, then runtime copies it into span attrs and logs. We already parse traceparent for trace_id.

khurana: We'll add header whitelist in api-gw config: ["traceparent","x-request-id","x-rw-trace-sampled","b3","tracecontext"] and keep a hard cap of 5 custom headers. Also: the gateway will normalize incoming route to the low-card route tag (route id) and inject X-RW-Route.

lina: Two risks:
- cardinality explosion if route names include user IDs — runtime must normalize before tagging
- sampling mismatch if some services ignore propagated sampled header
We should add a validation check in CI that ensures all services honor X-RW-Trace-Sampled or at least log when they override it.

ash: UI asks: can we show an "effective sampling rate" per route so p99 values can be adjusted/annotated? If so, we can show both raw and sample-adjusted metrics.

jana: Yes. Runtime can emit a metric `trace.sampling.effective_rate{route=...,env=...}` which can be updated by the edge sampling controller. Low-cardinality.

raj: Product question — how will rollout look? We need to avoid sudden dashboards with missing data. Suggest a canary: enable headers + tags on 10% of traffic, monitor metrics and dashboards, then 100% rollout.

matt: Agreed. Plan: canary for 2 days at 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Add a prominent "trace coverage" panel in Console so we can watch effective_rate.

obs-bot: ticket created: RH-OBS-1248 "Trace header propagation + dashboard contract" assigned to jana, khurana, ash.

khurana: Action items I/O:
- infra: whitelist headers, inject X-RW-Route, add dynamic sampling controller (owner: khurana) — ETA 2024-08-02
- runtime: honor X-RW-Trace-Sampled, emit `trace.sampling.effective_rate` and structured logs as above (owner: jana) — ETA 2024-08-09
- devex: Console panels for p50/p95/p99 per-route + trace coverage + link by req_id (owner: ash) — ETA 2024-08-12
- SRE: add CI validation to detect unnormalized route tags and sampling overrides (owner: lina) — ETA 2024-08-09

lina: I'll also add an alert if effective_rate drops below expected for a route (we'll need SLAs on coverage for critical routes).

matt: One last note: let's standardize on header casing: use lowercase in config (traceparent, x-request-id, x-rw-trace-sampled). We'll document the contract in the RH-OBS-1248 ticket.

ash: Thanks all — can we confirm owners and I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to unblock questions? :thumbsup:

jana: confirmed owner and will bring a small patch to the runtime repo for review tomorrow.

khurana: confirmed.

lina: confirmed.

raj: thanks, will prep product notes for the rollout UI copy.

matt: great sync. I'll update the ticket with these notes and the rollout plan.
